opus_only: Price trend-following is the core style of a managed futures industry with about $198bn of assets at end-2022, indicating the scale of capital already deployed in trend.
Brooks, Katz and Lustig (2018) show bond markets underreact persistently to monetary policy (FOMC) surprises (post-FOMC announcement drift), evidence of macro underreaction in rates.
QP01-C02-R2b

Most direct evidence of underreaction comes from single stocks; evidence for macro assets (index, bond, FX, commodity markets) is thinner, so the foundation is less established for the assets this strategy trades.
QP01-C03-R2b
Investors value trend-following mainly for positive returns during market drawdowns, which is why the paper judges economic trend and the blend largely by drawdown performance.
Inflation theme = 12-month change in CPI inflation forecasts; rising forecasts are bearish equities and fixed income, bullish currencies and commodities.
QP01-C04-R1b
The theme-to-asset-class signs are asserted a priori (e.g. rising growth is good for equities) rather than estimated from predictive regressions.
Economic trend Sharpe ratios are positive for all 15 equity indices, from about 0.10 (S&P 500) to about 0.47 (OMX Copenhagen).
Economic trend Sharpe ratios are positive for all 9 government bond futures, from about 0.08 (Australia) to about 0.49 (Swiss).
Commodity Sharpe ratios are positive but dispersed: industrial metals and energy higher, coffee, natural gas and sugar near zero.
In each of the five worst US 10-year Treasury drawdowns since 1970 economic trend made money, averaging about +39% versus about -14% for Treasuries.
Price and economic trend should be positively but imperfectly correlated, since good fundamental news is followed by positive returns on average.
QP01-C09-R1b
Only some of the worst-drawdown episodes are explained by the price-vs-fundamentals story; the authors use the Tech Bubble as the illustrating case, so the narrative evidence is partial.

In the sudden October 1987 crash price trend lost (about -10%) while economic trend gained (about +23%), illustrating that economic trend covers fast catalyst-driven sell-offs that price trend misses.

The reference list dates Hurst-Ooi-Pedersen as 2014 while footnotes 2 and 11 cite it as 2017, and several in-text citations (Campbell 1991, Katz-Lustig 2017, Bernanke-Kuttner 2005, Eichenbaum-Evans 1995, Clarida-Waldman 2008) are not listed.
The backtest is a proof of concept; better or additional economic trend measures could improve it.
Trade signal is the one-year change in the spot rate against an export-weighted basket, from DataStream.
A depreciating currency is bearish bonds (less need for rate cuts) and bearish commodities (dollar-priced commodities cost more for consumers with weaker currencies).

The appendix says easing is bullish equities, currencies and commodities and bearish bonds, but the currency and bond signs conflict with Exhibit 1 (rising 2y yield: currency +, bonds -) and with Eichenbaum-Evans (tightening appreciates the currency).
Rising risk appetite is bullish equities, commodities and currencies and bearish bonds.
sonnet_only: A combined price plus economic trend strategy has better risk-adjusted results than either alone (note: Exhibit 6 shows blend does not beat price trend in currencies or commodities).
Commodities were excluded from Brooks (2017) because cross-sectional relative-value views are less intuitive; the directional design makes adding them reasonable.
Persistent bull market in the Tech Bubble made price trend perform exceptionally well even as economic trend suffered.
